purpose: Teach: 吹雪/かぜ/つゆ/ぬき/エスカレーター/キッズ/段差/中高

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、雪国で、絶対、吹雪、絶対、見たことあるわ
lines.en: Sho, I'm telling you — I've definitely seen a blizzard in the snow country before.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Lean toward Sho with affection. Unhurried pace. The tone of sharing a small memory with someone you want to include.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、かぜ、絶対、ひいちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm serious — I really did catch a cold.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest intensity. No exaggeration in the voice — just stating fact. Soft, steady delivery. Looking up at her with genuine concern about this news.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お素麺の、絶対、つゆ、絶対、手作りで、絶対、用意したわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I made the somen broth from scratch, I really did.
lines.style: Gentle and deliberate. Soft attack on each phrase. The care-taking tone of someone making sure he knows how much thought went into this. Warm smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お野菜、絶対、ぬき、絶対、で、絶対、食べてもいい?本気で
lines.en: Mei-sis, can I really eat it without the vegetables?
lines.style: Small, hopeful question. Light and slightly eager. A child testing boundaries but not quite ready to be told no. Pause before the final question mark.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんと、本気で、絶対、デパートの、絶対、エスカレーター、絶対、乗ろうね、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, let's ride the escalator at the department store together, okay?
lines.style: Animated and inviting. Quick, brightened pace. The tone of someone offering a small adventure. Gentle emphasis on the 'together' — including him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、キッズ、絶対、向け、絶対、絵本、絶対、好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really like kids' picture books.
lines.style: Soft, genuine admission. Slight hesitation before saying it — like it's something he's pleased about but a little shy to share. Steady, unhurried rhythm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 公園の、本気で、絶対、段差、絶対、翔くん、絶対、ジャンプ、絶対、しないでね
lines.en: At the park, please don't jump over the steps, okay Sho?
lines.style: Careful, protective tone without sounding alarmed. Quiet but clear. The firmness of someone looking out for him. Gentle close on the question.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼくのお兄ちゃん、絶対、中高、絶対、一貫校、絶対、なんだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, my older brother goes to a combined middle and high school.
lines.style: Animated, eager to share new information. Bright delivery. The tone of a child offering up a detail he's proud to tell. Light, conversational pace.
